description: US employer FICA for 2026: Social Security 6.2% up to the $184,500 wage base plus Medicare 1.45% with no cap; no employer match on the 0.9% Additional Medicare Tax. FUTA, state unemployment and workers' compensation are not included. United States (IRS Topic 751, SSA), as of 2026-11-22. General estimate only: not payroll or tax advice, no filing. Items not verified are listed as not included.
